Chiikawa official manga style educational illustration, 4:3, explaining 数据库迁移步骤 (Database Migration Steps). === TITLE === "数据库迁移四阶段 (Four Stages of Database Migration)" — floating typography, NOT anchored to any solid band or box; coral-pink (#FF8E9E) bold rounded font with White Outer Glow and Subtle Drop Shadow for legibility on light backgrounds; surrounded by small pastel flowers, twinkling stars, and tiny hearts woven naturally into the scene === SCENE & LAYOUT === Layout: Linear process flow with labeled stages; each stage has a description bubble below it, resembling stepping stones on a path Background: Soft gradient cream (#FFF8E7) to light-sky-blue (#E1F5FE), minimal scattered fluffy clouds and database icon decorations === MAIN CONTENT === Use official Chiikawa characters such as Chiikawa / Hachiware / Usagi with clearly different appearances and roles [CONTENT_SECTION_1] Character: Chiikawa (吉伊) - Chiikawa, the tiny white marshmallow character, stands nervously at the first stepping stone, looking determined - Holds a small shovel Visual: Two databases—one old and faded, one new and shiny Label: "阶段1：双写 (Phase 1: Dual Write)" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) Dialogue: "要开始了！(It's starting!)" [CONTENT_SECTION_2] Character: Hachiware (小八) - Hachiware, the blue-marked cat, stands on the second stepping stone, clipboard in hand - Points to the databases with a confident expression Visual: Database servers showing data flow Label: "阶段2：读写分离 (Phase 2: Read-Write Separation)" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) Dialogue: "没问题，读写分离进行中！(No problem, read-write separation in progress!)" [CONTENT_SECTION_3] Character: Usagi (乌萨奇) - Usagi, the tall beige rabbit, jumps excitedly onto the third stepping stone - Arms raised in victory Visual: Arrows indicating data flow being switched Label: "阶段3：完全切换 (Phase 3: Complete Switchover)" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) Dialogue: "哇！全部切过去了！(Wow! All switched over!)" [CONTENT_SECTION_4] Character: Chiikawa (吉伊) - Chiikawa, the tiny white marshmallow character, waves goodbye to the old database - Holding a tiny flag Visual: The old database fades away Label: "阶段4：老库下线 (Phase 4: Old Database Shutdown)" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) Dialogue: "再见了，老朋友。(Goodbye, old friend.)" [CONTENT_SECTION_5] Character: Hachiware (小八) - Hachiware, the blue-marked cat, stands next to a database server, giving a thumbs up - Clipboard shows successful migration report Visual: The new database is shining brightly Label: "写入同时落两个库
以老库为准 (Write to both databases simultaneously, using the old database as the standard)" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) Dialogue: "双写确认，安全第一！(Dual write confirmed, safety first!)" [CONTENT_SECTION_6] Character: Usagi (乌萨奇) - Usagi, the tall beige rabbit, happily reads from the new database - A thought bubble shows data being retrieved quickly Visual: New database glowing with efficiency Label: "写入新库
读新库为主/老库兜底 (Write to the new database, read mainly from the new database/old database as backup)" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) Dialogue: "速度真快！(So fast!)" [CONTENT_SECTION_7] Character: Chiikawa (吉伊) - Chiikawa, the tiny white marshmallow character, checks the data flow one last time - Holding a magnifying glass, inspecting the switchover Visual: Arrows cleanly pointing to the new database Label: "全部流量切到新库
老库只读保留 7 天 (All traffic switched to the new database, old database read-only for 7 days)" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) Dialogue: "检查完毕！(Check complete!)" [CONTENT_SECTION_8] Character: Hachiware (小八) - Hachiware, the blue-marked cat, flips the switch to power off the old database - Wears safety goggles Visual: Old database shuts down safely Label: "确认无异常后下线老库 (Shutdown the old database after confirming no anomalies)" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) Dialogue: "确认安全，下线！(Confirmed safe, shutting down!)" === KEY CONCEPTS === 4 floating info boxes; each box uses a semi-transparent cloud-like blob background (marshmallow-soft, pure white at 70–80% opacity, no hard border), text in dark charcoal (#2D2D2D), medium-weight sans-serif: Box 1: "双写 (Dual Write): 同时写入新旧数据库，确保数据一致 (Write to both new and old databases simultaneously to ensure data consistency)" Box 2: "读写分离 (Read-Write Separation): 新库处理写入，旧库处理读取，减轻新库压力 (New database handles writes, old database handles reads, reducing pressure on the new database)" Box 3: "完全切换 (Complete Switchover): 所有流量切换到新库，旧库只读备份 (All traffic switches to the new database, old database serves as read-only backup)" Box 4: "老库下线 (Old Database Shutdown): 确认新库稳定后，安全下线旧数据库 (Safely shut down the old database after confirming the new database is stable)" === CHIIKAWA STYLE === Official Chiikawa aesthetic: round bodies, large sparkly eyes, pink blush marks, tiny limbs, super deformed proportions, gentle line art === TEXT RENDERING === Typography rules (CRITICAL — apply to every label, title, and annotation): - Title: floating typography with White Outer Glow or Subtle Drop Shadow — NO solid background band; title integrates naturally into the illustrated scene with decorative Chiikawa elements around it - All labels placed inside semi-transparent cloud-like blobs (marshmallow-soft, pure white at 70–80% opacity, no hard borders) — soft edges naturally blend into the illustrated background - Font: bold (600–700) rounded sans-serif for title; medium-weight (500–600) for labels; NO thin, cursive, or brush-stroke fonts - Text color: dark charcoal (#2D2D2D) on the light blob background; minimum contrast 4.5:1 - Chinese characters: every stroke and radical must be Fully Formed and Vector-style clarity — no hairline breaks, no missing components, no pixelation - Smooth anti-aliased edges; absolutely NO cracked, fragmented, or glitchy strokes === MOOD === Informative, reassuring, cute but informative Quality: High-quality Chiikawa illustration, clear visual hierarchy, for educational purposes
